title: Learning & Development Specialist
summary: A learning and development (L&D) specialist finds where employees lack skills, then designs, runs and measures training to close those gaps, from new-joiner induction to programmes for new managers. The role sits in the HR team and works with HR business partners and business heads.
dailyDuties: Run training needs analysis with managers and HR business partners
Design training content and short e-learning modules
Deliver classroom and virtual training sessions
Enrol learners and pull completion reports from the LMS
Collect feedback and assessment scores to measure training effectiveness
Update the training calendar and monthly L&D MIS

skills.expectation: Find skill gaps through surveys, interviews and manager inputs and turn them into a training plan
Design programmes and build content, from classroom decks to short e-learning modules
Run classroom and virtual training sessions and workshops
Set up courses, enrol learners and pull completion reports from the LMS
Measure training with feedback, assessments and business results, often using the Kirkpatrick levels
Run induction and onboarding programmes for new joiners
Coordinate programmes for first-time managers and emerging leaders
Keep the training calendar, attendance and MIS in Excel
Agree priorities with HR business partners and business leaders
Present confidently to groups and write clear learning material
Build L&D dashboards on hours, completion and impact
Link development plans to talent reviews and succession
Pull employee data from the HRMS for targeting and reports
